query:
SELECT sets as "value!", COUNT(*) as "count!" 
        FROM (
            SELECT pdf_id, COUNT(*) AS sets
            FROM logs_problem_set INNER JOIN logs_pdf ON logs_problem_set.pdf_id = logs_pdf.id
            WHERE logs_pdf.created_at >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'utc') - $1::interval
            GROUP BY pdf_id
        ) sub_query
        GROUP BY sets
        ORDER BY sets DESC;
